summary: OKYO Pharma Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026 to report that its Chief Scientific Officer, Raj Patil, purchased 3,363 ordinary shares at $1.49 per share on NASDAQ, increasing his holdings to 20,030 shares. This insider open-market purchase is a routine disclosure by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16; it does not constitute any corporate event such as a tender offer, capital return, or activist campaign. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural mechanics are involved. The filing is purely informational and does not require any regulatory or shareholder action. There is nothing to watch or trade on.
